object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: On a clean 64-bit Windows 10 virtual machine and on a clean 64-bit Windows 11 one, install Mellon and, on a copy of the req-test fixture, open the repository in the GUI, edit an object, commit from the commit dialog, export VCU3-SRS to PDF, and connect an MCP client to mellon-mcp.exe. Expected: each step works on both machines.
